Class AmwpFacade.TextSink

java.lang.Object
org.aetheris.ssh.AmwpFacade.TextSink
All Implemented Interfaces:
PoolChat.Sink
Enclosing class:
AmwpFacade
private static final class AmwpFacade.TextSink extends Object implements PoolChat.Sink
The TextSink class collects a console pool reply. A thought rides the stream channel. The terminal stays the reply. A reason becomes the banner.
Author:
clayl (2026-09-02)

    • TextSink

      TextSink(AmwpFacade facade, String user)

  • Method Details

    • thought

      public void thought(String chunk)
      The thought method writes one thought chunk on the nil cell. A null or empty chunk returns without writing. A null facade returns without writing. A missing console sink returns without writing. A successful write sets the opened flag. A send failure is ignored. A closed mux leaves the VT100 reply intact.
      Specified by:
      thought in interface PoolChat.Sink
      Parameters:
      chunk - The chunk is the thought text.

    • message

      public void message(String chunk)
      The message method appends one reply chunk. A null chunk is skipped.
      Specified by:
      message in interface PoolChat.Sink
      Parameters:
      chunk - The chunk is the reply text.

    • done

      public void done(String reason, String message)
      The done method finishes the console pool turn. A non-empty reason stores the message, or the reason when the message is empty. That stored text becomes the failure. A non-empty message with an empty reason replaces the collected text.
      Specified by:
      done in interface PoolChat.Sink
      Parameters:
      reason - The reason is the pool reason, or empty on success.
      message - The message is the final text, or the failure text.

    • text

      String text() throws Exception
      The text method returns the collected assistant text. A stored failure throws Exception with that failure.
      Returns:
      The return value is the assistant text.
      Throws:
      Exception - The exception is the pool reason.

    • opened

      boolean opened()
      The opened method reports whether a thought was written on the stream channel.
      Returns:
      The return value is true when a thought frame was sent.
